name: io.foundplay/foundplay
title: Foundplay
description: Search free browser games on Foundplay, a game discovery platform for free browser games.

tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Searches the free browser games listed on Foundplay, made by independent creators, many with AI tools. Use it for any request for browser games to play: by genre or kind, on a phone, with friends, made with AI, or new this week. Examples: {"query": "zombie"}; {"genre": "racing", "phone": true}; {"aiMade": true, "sort": "new"}. Matches the query against titles, one-line descriptions and genres; a game whose title, main genre or tag has a query word comes first. English words in the query for a phone, friends, made with AI or new turn on those filters and that order (see intent). Returns catalog device and multiplayer facts, counted outbound clicks, upvotes, creator credit and Foundplay page links. Read-only. Defaults to most played; best uses the website's quality ranking, with its method and limits, not a review. aiMade requires recorded AI-creation provenance. The query may be in Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian or Indonesian; with lang, pitches and links are in that language where translated.

query.description: Words required in the title, description or genre, such as 'zombie shooter' or 'cozy farm'. The phone, multiplayer, aiMade and sort inputs are the exact way to ask for those; in English, words such as 'phone', '2 player', 'made with AI' and 'new' in the query also turn them on, and filler such as 'free', 'online' and 'games' is dropped. Leave empty or omit for broad discovery with filters.

phone.description: true for catalog phone support, such as touch controls. Not a physical-device test or a guarantee for every iPhone, Android device or browser.

multiplayer.description: true for catalog multiplayer support, online or on one screen. Does not guarantee online play or a particular player count.

aiMade.description: true requires recorded evidence of AI-assisted creation, using the website's AI-made list rules. False or omitted does not filter by AI use; missing evidence is unknown.

sort.description: popular (all-time counted clicks, the default), trending (last 48 hours), new (newest Foundplay listings, not original release dates), or best (the website's quality ranking of eligible originals).

limit.description: How many games to return. Default 8.

lang.description: The language the person is asking in: es (Spanish), pt (Portuguese), de (German), fr (French), it (Italian) or id (Indonesian). The query is read in that language, and each pitch and page link is in it where Foundplay has a translation, else English. en keeps the query English. Omitted, a query plainly in one of the six is read in it.
